title: C# Editor ignores changes made to resources exported with default values.
body: ### Tested versions - Found In: v4.8.dev6.mono.official [8898c2b3d] - Reproducible in: - v4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf] - v4.7.1.stable.mono.official **[a13da4feb]** - .Net Versions: 10 and 8 ### System information Godot v4.8.dev6.mono - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors (2560x1440 @ 143.91 Hz, 2560x1440 @ 143.91 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K (28 threads) - 62.56 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Current Behavior: When an exported resource has a default value of `new()` , any changes made to the resources values in the editor will be ignored when the game is actually running. The values do not get saved to the .tscn file and reloading the project will reset them to the defaults set in code. Example property default: ``` [Export] public OuterResource OuterResource { get; set; } = new(); ``` Before Project Reload: After Project Reload: Ignored Values While Running: Expected Behavior: Updating values in an exported resource using the editor overrides the default values for the instance of the resource in the scene. Existing Workaround: Not setting default values for these resource exports fixes this issue but requires manual configuration for every resource. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open Root.tscn in the attached MRP 2. Select Node3D root node in the Scene editor 3. Expand OuterResource and InnerResource in the inspector and update the default values for `Outer Value` and `Inner Value` 4. Run the scene 5. See that the reported values from the `_Ready` method report the defaults of 2 and 3, not the values set in step 3. 6. Open the Root.tscn file in a text editor and see it is not storing any of the updated values. 7. In the godot editor select `Project > Reload Current Project` 8. See the values for `Outer Value` and `Inner Value` have reverted to their defaults set in code. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [ResourceExportMRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32638698/ResourceExportMRP.zip)
